name: Pro Launch

sources.title: Pricing — Free (badge→dofollow) / Startup $7.99 / Premium $39.99 with SEO article; add-ons listed

conditions: Free Launch is nofollow — adding the Pro Launch badge to your site converts it to a dofollow backlink at no cost
25 free slots weekly, standard launch queue
requirements: Account required: Google, GitHub, or email sign-in before /projects/submit
Launches happen at 8:00 AM UTC in weekly batches
preparation: Project name, URL, description, category, logo
Badge on your site if you want free-tier dofollow

Plan: Free $0 / Startup $7.99 per launch (guaranteed dofollow, earlier dates, up to 90-day scheduling, 1 relaunch after 30-day cooldown) / Premium $39.99 (dedicated '[Product] review' SEO article, premium spotlight, 5 relaunches that keep upvotes/comments/ranking)
Optional add-ons: Sponsored Listing $59.99/month, guest post $29.99 one-time
workflow: Choose plan and pick a launch date (up to 90 days out on paid)
Free: place the badge so the listing earns dofollow
Launch in the 8:00 AM UTC batch; homepage feature + community engagement
watchFor: Free tier is nofollow WITHOUT the badge — the badge is doing the SEO work
Premium's headline value is the dedicated SEO article; check the published review examples for quality
Relaunch economics: Startup gets 1 relaunch (30-day cooldown), Premium gets 5 with preserved engagement
Badge Terms page exists (/legal/badges) — read it for removal conditions
Footer is saturated with reciprocal directory badges — typical badge-network profile
countsAsLive: Project page on prolaunch.net live from its scheduled 8:00 AM UTC launch, listed in All Projects and featured on the homepage
unknowns: Free queue length / scheduling window for free tier
